name: mothership-sea
notes: Mothership nautical concept (Colby, recording 2026-09-08 10:53). Three Seedance shots chained through the keyframes as first and last frames (K1→K2, K2→K3, K3→K4), so the join between shots is the shared frame and the film is one continuous take; then a cut to black. Native sea ambience.

render.prompt: The empty misty evening sea under a strong double rainbow; slowly the rainbow softens and a bank of fog begins to roll in from the left while, on the horizon, a tall three-masted 1800s ship of the line emerges as a small silhouette under full sail and begins to approach. Photoreal live-action cinematography, one continuous locked-off shot from a low vantage just above the water; long slow swells, drifting mist, fine film grain, true-to-life colour; the camera does not move; no people, no text, no logos. Ambient sound only: the sea, a low wind, the distant creak of rigging and a faint ship's bell.
